lines.text: When I opened my bakery, it was one licence… then another… then a fee nobody had written down anywhere.
My file just sat on someone's desk. Day ten. Day twenty-one. Then a man asked me for money.
That's why we made India Business One. Every licence, every fee, every desk your file sits on.
You type in your shop's address, and it tells you your corporation, your zone, your ward.
Then every licence you need, what it really costs, and the rule that says so.
You can see whose desk your file is on, and what to do if it gets stuck.
And if someone asks you for a bribe, you note it down quietly, and report it when you're ready.
It's free, it's open source… come build it with us.
